svg.aria-label: Data flow of the Henkel order-to-cash case, table by table. Henkel's two SQL files load 15 Bronze src_ tables; they feed 18 Silver tables (three built from other Silver tables), 9 Gold tables, the star schema of 10 Semantic tables and 12 Analytical mart views, which the Power BI report reads. Each line is one table read in the SQL (69 reads between tables).
svg.title: Henkel order-to-cash data flow
